title: Sony BRAVIA 4K VH2 (device BRAVIA_VH2, KD-55X80J, MediaTek), EU firmware
header:
Sony BRAVIA 4K VH2 (device BRAVIA_VH2, KD-55X80J, MediaTek), EU firmware
Android 12 (Google TV, API 31), build BRAVIA_VH2_EU-user 12 STT2.230505.001.S136 682241

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-vh2/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-vh2/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (Google TV). Pass it to restore.sh as above.
Live TV / tuner app: com.sony.dtv.tvx (set it as live_tv_package in the launcher's config.xml and hide it).
Keep the com.sony.dtv.tvinput.* services, com.sony.dtv.braviasync*, com.sony.dtv.tvapi,
com.sony.dtv.sonysystemservice, imeproxy, settingsprovider, systemupdate/update (firmware), the Sony
settings apps and all com.mediatek.*: they drive HDMI, the tuner, Bravia Sync, updates and the remote.
Kept by owner's choice: voice assistant (katniss, voicesearch, assistantadapter), Chromecast built-in
(mediashell) and firmware updates.
Already disabled at the factory: com.sony.dtv.promos, com.sony.dtv.b2b.vendorprotocol,
com.sony.dtv.b2b.softap, com.apple.atve.sony.appletv, the my5/itv/ard/all4/iplayer/sounds launchers,
com.youview.poa, de.hdplus.tvapp.androidtv, com.sony.dtv.seeds.iot, com.sonypicturescore.
Not in this list, so restore.sh leaves them as they are.

Live TV in the launcher: set live_tv_package to com.sony.dtv.tvx and hide it; Inputs lists HDMI 1-4 and
AV from the TV input framework. Launcher installed with the Input-button service (INPUT_KEY_SERVICE=1).
Applied one afternoon on a KD-55X80J with the dock set to Stremio, Netflix, SmartTube, OTT Navigator.
Not yet lived with for weeks; if something breaks, re-enable it with `pm enable <package>` and please
report it. launcherx was left enabled, since Home already resolved to the new launcher once the setup
wizard was disabled.

Second unit, North American firmware: build BRAVIA_VH2_M_UC-user 12 STT2.230505.001.S136 682241,
same board and the same build number as the EU unit above. Every package in this list is present and
every one disabled cleanly, but two things differ:

- Home handover needs the stock launcher disabled. On this firmware launcherx registers its HOME
intent filter at priority=2, which outranks the preference `cmd package set-home-activity` writes:
it prints Success while `resolve-activity` keeps naming launcherx. Disabling setupwraith alone did
not hand Home over either, so the note above about leaving launcherx enabled does not hold here.
Disabling it (the commented line at the end of this list) handed Home over at once, and the TV has
booted to the new launcher since. Check with `dumpsys activity activities | grep mFocusedApp`, not
with the "Success" from set-home-activity.
- promos, seeds.iot and b2b.vendorprotocol ship ENABLED here, where the EU unit has them off at the
factory; sonyselect and seeds.iot.remotestart are enabled too and were not named either way above.
They are in the list below, so one file covers both regions: on an EU set they are already disabled
and recovery.py records that, so undo leaves them alone.

The Input-button service was NOT needed on this unit: with launcherx disabled, the remote's Input,
gear and app buttons were all still answered by Sony's own firmware (checked on the real remote, not
with injected keys), so INPUT_KEY_SERVICE was left off and key auto-repeat kept. On Ethernet, so the
setupwraith Wi-Fi check did not apply. Applied over one evening, not lived with for days.
